headlines.title: Applied Optoelectronics Is Up 175% in 2026 and Lumentum Is Up 164%: Take Profits, or Hold On for the Ride?

headlines.title: Lumentum (LITE) Is Down 8.8% After Long‑Term AI Optics Commitments Raise New Demand Questions
headlines.summary: Earlier this week, Lumentum Holdings, Astera Labs, and Corning showcased a joint PCIe‑over‑optics demonstration for AI rack‑scale architectures at the OCP Global Summit, while Lumentum’s CEO highlighted that demand for its optical components is largely booked through 2029. The combination of long‑term product commitments and emerging doubts about the durability of AI infrastructure spending has created a complex picture for Lumentum’s role in the AI data center supply chain.

headlines.title: Lumentum’s Massive Backlog and Demand Justify Buying at Today’s Price
headlines.summary: Lumentum's backlog just crossed a landmark threshold, demand is outrunning supply, and the stock is down nearly 10% from its recent peak. Whether that selloff is a buying window or a warning depends on one question the company has not fully answered yet.

headlines.title: AAOI, LITE, COHR Extend Sell-Off Overnight: AI Funding Fears Hit Optical Networking Trade, But Retail Bulls Eye Rebound
headlines.summary: AI spending concerns rattle optical stocks after strong year-to-date gains amid robust demand for high-speed connectivity.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
